name: @vip/service-workflow
description: Workflow service (Phase 1, P1-8) — owns the incident lifecycle. Consumes `incident.candidate` off NATS JetStream and idempotently promotes it into a persisted Incident (`raised`), then drives operator transitions (`acknowledged → resolved → closed`) via a permission-gated API, publishing `incident.raised|acknowledged|resolved|closed`. Every incident carries an end-to-end `correlationId`. The Alert Engine (notify) consumes `incident.raised` — never the rule candidate. Escalation/cases/on-call are future. See docs/architecture/22-BOUNDED-CONTEXTS.md §9, 11-WORKFLOW-ENGINE.md, docs/architecture/phase1/INCIDENT_LIFECYCLE.md.
